title: Three Mondays and One Short Strap
subtitle: 山川山地 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 山川山地（人与自然·自然生态·山川与地形）
meta: 主题语境：山川山地（人与自然·自然生态·山川与地形）　|　核心词汇：knee　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 knee 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the guide ① bandaged the knee that no climber in the valley would have recorded, and he said the bandaging was the whole of the Monday. The ② knee, meaning the joint itself and not the strap, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a knee, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ knee in that valley had the same short strap beside it, and the ④ knee at the far ledge, meaning the brace they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A knee, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the guide said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the knee was the whole of the matter, meaning the rest and not the joint. The ⑥ knee, meaning the rest and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; knee, he said, is either something you bandage or the only word that means both a joint and a rest. He said the rest is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ knee had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short strap. The ⑧ knee of the whole thing, the guide wrote in June, was one valley and three Mondays of recording; knee, he said, is either the brace at the far ledge or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ knee I remember is the joint recorded in the log, which closed in 1993 and is still recorded as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ knee, my mother said in 1995, is the only joint that improves by being recorded; every knee, she said, is a rest that has agreed to look like a joint. She said the rest was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 膝盖；膝关节（指山谷里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 膝盖；膝关节（指那个膝盖本身，与绑带相对）
C. 固定搭配：bandage the knee 包扎这个膝盖
D. n. 膝盖；膝关节（指留给孩子们背的那副护具那一个）
E. n. 攀爬之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的膝盖之事）
F. n. 膝盖；膝关节（指记录里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 歇息、驻足（指一件事里人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 驻足（抽象总称，指人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bandaged the knee that no climber in the valley would have recorded
The knee, meaning the joint itself and not the strap
the knee at the far ledge
the knee was the whole of the matter
the knee had become a line in a log
The knee of the whole thing
A knee, my mother said in 1995

answers.why: bandage the knee 意为“包扎这个膝盖”，1986 年那位向导把山谷里没有一位登山者肯记载的一个膝盖做了一遍。
knee 意为“膝盖；膝关节”，指那个膝盖本身而不是绑带，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
knee 意为“膝盖；膝关节”，指山谷里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根窄窄的绑带。
knee 意为“膝盖；膝关节”，指最远那道岩台留给孩子们背的那副护具那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
knee 意为“歇息、驻足”，指一件事里人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次歇息就是那件事的全部。
knee 意为“驻足”，指人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个膝盖，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
knee 意为“膝盖；膝关节”，指记录里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1991 年这一个成了记录里的一行。
knee 意为“攀爬之事”，向导六月写道，整件事的膝盖之事是一处山谷和三个星期一的记载。
knee 意为“膝盖；膝关节”，我记得的是记录里记载过的那一个，1993 年养好了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一个。
knee 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，膝盖是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的膝盖。
